caption:
Longevity Life Academy is delighted to invite you to The Longevity Masterclass Event of the Year.

Tonight, Tuesday, October 27, at 7:00 PM ET, live on Zoom. Reserve your seat here: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
If you can't make it tonight, there is a second live session on Saturday, November 14, at 1:00 PM ET.

Julie Gibson Clark is the second slowest aging person ever measured. Her epigenetic tests show she ages about 6.5 years in every decade. She is 56, a single mom and a recruiter from Phoenix, and she did this without a private lab, a team of doctors or a fortune to spend. In this masterclass she opens up her real protocol and teaches it to you herself, live.

Here is what Julie will cover in the hour:
• How the speed of aging is actually measured, and what moves it
• The three things that show up in her biomarkers
• Her rules for food, sleep and movement, in numbers: lights out at 9, up at 5, dinner by 6, a pound of vegetables a day, protein first
• Her full day from 5:00 am to 9:00 pm, built to repeat
• Her four supplements, about $100 a month in total
• Four popular longevity habits she says are not worth your money
• The one change she wants you to make on Monday

The masterclass starts at $49 for the full 60-minute live session. VIP access adds a private 30-minute Q&A with Julie after the class.

You choose your date at checkout. Live seats are limited, and both options come with a 14-day full refund.
Reserve your seat here: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass

A word about us. Longevity Life Academy is eTeacher Group's school for healthy aging. We started it because longevity expertise should not belong only to people who can spend millions on it. It should be within reach of everyday Americans. So we bring the leading longevity instructors into live classes and help every student build a personal protocol for a longer, better life.

Tonight we open our doors for a rare opportunity. We hope you will join us.
